plainText:
Cervantis (Japanese: クレイブ Crave) is a recurring character in . He is the current director of Exceed and leader of the Explorers, the son-in-law of Gibeon, and Amethio's father.

==History==
===Pre-series===
 
Cervantis was the son-in-law of the Explorers boss, Gibeon. As a younger man he married Gibeon's daughter, , and had a son, Amethio. Cervantis was later placed as the figurehead director of Exceed, a scientific research company founded by Gibeon.

During his time as an employee at Exceed, Friede became friendly with Cervantis. Cervantis's son, Amethio, would go on to become a follower of Gibeon.

=== ===
In The Treasure of Eternity, Friede arrived in the office of his former boss and apologized for having left the company in the past for his own selfish reasons, but Cervantis was quick to forgive him. Later, after Amethio finished meeting with his grandfather, Amethio mentioned that he was nothing like his father and that he would obtain more Laquium. This could suggest that Cervantis was once asked by Gibeon to acquire Laquium for the Explorers, and that Cervantis either failed or refused to do so.

In Entei's Fierce Battle Cry!, Amethio met with Cervantis before leaving. Shortly after, Spinel met with Cervantis, aware that he was Amethio's father.

In The Truth Revealed!, Amethio discovered that Spinel had completely infiltrated Exceed and was running the company without Cervantis's consent, having co-opted the company's security team and acting without Cervantis suspecting anything.

In Where the Adventure Leads, a year after Gibeon's death, it was revealed that Cervantis was no longer the director of Exceed and that Spinel had taken over all operations that were run by Gibeon.

In Following Traces of Laquium, Hamber revealed that Cervantis resigned from his position after Gibeon's death and that they both did not believe Spinel's reports that Amethio was to blame for it.

In Charcadet's Wish, while working at an Exceed factory, Cervantis received a call from Zirc and Onia, who asked for a clue that would help them determine Amethio's whereabouts. Before he could answer, Spinel entered the room to do an inspection. Cervantis asked Spinel what the Strong Spheres really were, but was denied a clear answer before Spinel left. Afterward, he sent Zirc and Onia a message containing the information they requested.

In Tinkatuff's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Year!, it was revealed that Cervantis responded to a message from Liko, in which he asked if he could meet with the Rising Volt Tacklers in person. The email later turned out to be a trap orchestrated by the Explorers. In the next episode, it was revealed that Cervantis was held captive by the Explorers for going against Spinel and his power project, later, he was released by Dot and Hamber and revealed to them the existence of the Super Strong Sphere, a more powerful and improved version of the previous Strong Sphere. In the following episode, Cervantis with his group arrivied too late, as Amethio, Liko, Roy, and Ult have been defeated by five of the Six Heroes. Through Amethio's convincing, Cervantis decided to stop Spinel as he joins his son in helping gather more Zygarde Cells with Hamber accompanying them, before bidding Liko and her group farewell.

In Don't Give Up, Crocalor!, Cervantis was contacted by a video call from Dot in secret and informed about the Exceed Museum which is actually a data center with the Laquium Data stored inside but it's protected from external connections. In Dot and Penny's Top-Secret Mission!, it was revealed that he acted to get Dot and Penny inside the Museum facilities, however it was revealed that his access to Exceed was revoked and this caused them to attract the attention of the Explorers.

In HZ136, following Spinel's arrest and the truth behind Laquium, Cervantis retook his position as Exceed's director and also became its chariman, while additionally assuming leadership of the Explorers. He spoke in a press conference where he explained what Exceed would do to clear their name from Spinel's deceitful tenure. To this end, he recruited Friede again and assigned him and Yanga to handle the research on Laquium. After the press conference, he met with Amethio, who said he wanted to be by his father's side in this endeavor.

==Character==
Cervantis appears to be an ethical and fair person, having a long history of friendship with Friede. In The Truth Revealed!, it was revealed that Cervantis appears to have a complicated relationship with Amethio, who considers Hamber to be his real father. Though he is shown as being harsh to Amethio when he begged him for information regarding Gibeon, Cervantis did not believe that his son was responsible for the failures in Laqua and has carefully given information to those who are searching for him behind Spinel's back. During the events in Better, Farther, Stronger!, Cervantis begins working on improving his relationship with his son, and ultimately reconciles with him in HZ136.

It is unknown what kind of relationship Cervantis had with his wife, , but as shown in The Treasure of Eternity, he continues to wear his wedding ring even years after her death, suggesting that they had been a close couple.
